name: Swastik Pipe Ltd.
summary: Swastik Pipe Ltd. manufactures and exports a range of steel products, primarily focusing on Mild Steel (MS) and Carbon Steel Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) pipes and tubes, which are available in both black and galvanized finishes. The company's product portfolio also includes API Line Pipes, rigid PVC pipes, cold-rolled strips, hollow sections, specialized casing pipes, tubular poles, and solar mounting structures. These products serve diverse sectors such as agriculture for irrigation and borewells, infrastructure for structural applications, water supply, and the oil and gas industry for transportation of petroleum products. Additionally, their offerings cater to general engineering purposes, and various heavy industries including automotive, chemical, sugar, metallurgical, and power. Swastik Pipe Ltd. operates in both domestic and international markets, utilizing manufacturing facilities in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, and Kotwan, Uttar Pradesh.
